newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan fabric shares up on rising order hopes.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan fabric shares up on rising order hopes.

text.p: Taiwan's polyester fabrics shares rose on Wednesday on expectations that foreign buyers of goods would switch from South Korean suppliers, brokers said.
After 80 minutes, Li Peng Enterprises had surged T$1.2 or 5.06 percent to T$24.9 and Chia Her Industry was up 50 cents or 2.7 percent to T$19.

"Several South Korean polyester fabrics makers have recently reported financial troubles, and insiders expect foreign buyers are to likely transfer their orders to Taiwan makers," said Michael Hung, research chief at Nikko Securities.
Also, he said, these downstream polyester fabrics makers should benefit from recent upstream polyester material price declines.
